svg.title: How a witness cosigns
svg.desc: The log sends add-checkpoint: the old size the witness last cosigned, a consistency proof from it, and the new checkpoint. The witness checks the log signature, the old size against its stored state, and the proof, then stores the new size and root and returns a cosignature. The log publishes the checkpoint with its cosignatures; a client accepts it only with enough of them.
